ml_channel.signal_nature: Statistical analytical reference signals only. Not probabilities of criminality, intent, ownership, or legal culpability.

numerical_fusion.governance_rationale: Empirical support in development cohort contains zero sanctions-free positives (all 66 positive records are OFAC-sanctioned, deterministic score saturated at 100). The mathematical finding alpha=0 is a saturation artifact and ML incremental value is non-identifiable on current data. Independent channels preserved for safety.

model_combination.model_selection_policy: Both Logistic Regression and XGBoost are presented as independent analytical perspectives; no model is selected as the exclusive operational winner.

threshold_policy.policy_statement: No operational ML threshold is authorized. ML probabilities must not be mapped to CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW risk bands.

sanctions_policy.policy_statement: Within CHAKRA's deterministic risk policy, a verified sanctions match has strict deterministic precedence and cannot be overridden, attenuated, or dismissed by ML.

future_fusion_requirements.re_evaluation_condition: Numerical fusion can only be reconsidered after a new independently validated expansion dataset provides sufficient empirical support.
required_support: An adequately sized cohort of independent sanctions-free positive entities must be established through a separate prospective statistical support/power analysis before numerical fusion is reconsidered
Positive entities with non-zero intermediate deterministic scores (10 <= S_det <= 75) from observed typologies
Independent negative populations (ordinary retail/active users) to evaluate false-positive elevation
Adequate independent support across relevant chain and source strata must be demonstrated before fusion validation
future_fusion_requirements.final_test_isolation_rule: The existing 9-entity final test set cannot be reused as fusion-tuning data and remains permanently evaluation-only.
